title: Rei's four expression portraits
question: Which face should Rei use for scolding, cold, smug and caught off guard (one each)?

media.caption: Why: on Showcase register-reactions-1 (Rei's reaction line, desktop) you wrote "lacking emotion in the dialogue picture." Rei only has her neutral portrait, so these are four new faces for her dialogue box. All 15 attempts in order, faces only, the installed neutral first, each with its dashboard number. Only the face was repainted (brows to chin, inside the jaw line, below the fringe); hair, eyes' colour, gold hoops, suit and framing are the neutral's own pixels. The first three scolding tries (#1349-#1351) drew pointed vampire fangs and are rejected; the retry (#1367-#1369) adds "fang, fangs, sharp teeth" to the negative, nothing else.
The same 15 as game files (cut out, 533 x 838, the same scale and matte as rei-neutral.webp), the neutral first.
Image check: all 15 pass (red rim 0.0%, face drift ccip 0.007 to 0.019, framing unchanged). The cut-outs warn on 1 matte hole, which the installed neutral cut-out has too (same matte).

options.note: mouth open mid-word, eyes narrowed; the strongest scolding of the three. Words: "scolding, sharp displeased look, eyebrows drawn down, narrowed eyes, mouth open mid-word, looking at the viewer"; denoise 0.7, seed 1. Full prompt and negative in prompts.json. Checks: red rim 0.0% (pass), face drift ccip 0.011 (pass), cut-out uses the installed matte.
